name: Emby Federation & Bridge
description: Universal Emby-to-Jellyfin Federation Plugin: Native Emby Channel, Automatic Library Federation (.strm & .nfo with TMDb/TVDb/IMDb IDs), Zero-Buffer Direct Play Stream Proxy, Bi-Directional Watch State Sync, Multi-User Account Mapping & Seerr/Suggestarr Request Guard.
overview: Seamlessly federate remote Emby libraries into Jellyfin, Seerr, and Suggestarr with direct streaming and automatic request interception.

- Built-in Seerr / Jellyseerr / Suggestarr Webhook Guard & Availability API
